enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Animal Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt the natural, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Animals.
Tidal 6: This weapon is sheathed in water. A Tidal weapon deals an extra 6d6 points of damage on a successful hit. Creatures with the Fire trait take double this damage instead.

Cold Vulnerability: On Hit: Applies a stack of Vulnerable (1% more damage for 3 seconds. This effect stacks up to 20 times, and loses one stack on expiration.). This effect may only occur on-hit once every second.
Underwater Action: You have a +21 Competence bonus to Swim and can breathe underwater.
